returns encryption key JSON; blocked by nginx 'deny all' on /admin/ location

observations: Direct requests to /admin/* return 403 Forbidden from nginx reverse proxy.
The Flask app runs behind gunicorn on a unix domain socket, proxied by nginx.
Nginx config has 'underscores_in_headers on', allowing custom headers with underscores.
Gunicorn reads WSGI environmental variables from request headers, including SCRIPT_NAME.
SCRIPT_NAME is used by WSGI to calculate the application path_info; manipulating it can change what path Flask sees.
The nginx 'location ^~ /admin/' rule only matches the start of the raw request URI, not the WSGI-computed path.
